caption:
A ditch-digger's daily wage was ₹300. An Asian Games bronze medal doesn't ask what you used to do for money.

Ram Baboo dug ditches under a rural employment scheme and waited tables to fund his own race-walking training after a knee injury ended his running. He won bronze anyway. The training didn't care where the money for it came from - only that it kept showing up.
